description:
GREAT LOCATION FURNISHED ALLOCATED PARKING

Acorn properties are delighted to welcome to the market this one double bedroom apartment in Ochre yards. Open plan kitchen and living space, kitchen has fitted wall and floor units, dishwasher, ceramic hob and electric oven, large fridge/freezer. Double shower room. Furnished with balcony. Modern interior. Laminate flooring throughout apart from cream carpets in bedroom Close to Metro and 10 minutes walk to Newcastle City Centre. Allocated parking.
